justification: Brief showed 'Address not matched - check the address' for the DCP section when the real situation was a council we have not onboarded (e.g. Wingecarribee): backend reason said 'Former council could not be determined' and the frontend mapped any 'could not' to the address-mismatch card, blaming the user's input for our coverage gap. Reworded the backend reason to 'not onboarded' (routes to the honest 'Not assessed' card) and narrowed the frontend address-mismatch match to genuine resolution failures ('prop_id').

break_it.scenario: Council without onboarded DCP data (Wingecarribee) runs a brief
break_it.what_happens: DCP card now shows 'Not assessed - this council's DCP isn't in our dataset yet' instead of telling the user their address is wrong
break_it.how: test_none_dcp_no_lga pins the reason contains 'not onboarded' and not 'could not'; frontend 'not onboarded' branch renders the honest card

break_it.what_happens: sections with reason 'No prop_id resolved' still render the 'Address not matched' error card - the narrowed frontend match keeps the 'prop_id' token
break_it.how: frontend branch still matches 'prop_id'; all 'No prop_id resolved' reasons in intelligence_brief.py contain that token
break_it.repro: grep -n 'No prop_id resolved' services/intelligence_brief.py; run a brief with a nonsense address
